description: Hand a GitHub URL to the user's browser. The legal gate links to the five documents (UI-SPEC §4), the summary sheet's Report-bug deep link opens a prefilled issue (ERROR-CATALOG §4), and PD-SYS-001 links to the long-paths help. The webview cannot do this itself: connect-src in tauri.conf.json allows only 'self' and the IPC origin. SCOPED ON PURPOSE — an unscoped opener is a launch-anything primitive reachable from any injected string, which is the same reasoning SECURITY §2 applies to argv arrays.
